uitleg.nl: Onthoud de pagina, scrollpositie en het zoomniveau van deze PDF, ook nadat je hem sluit en weer opent. Zolang dit aan staat, staat er een klein bestand naast deze PDF; dat verschijnt dus ook in mappen die met de cloud synchroniseren (OneDrive, Dropbox, enz.). Uitzetten verwijdert dat bestand.
uitleg.en: Remember this PDF's page, scroll position and zoom across closing and reopening it. While switched on, a small file is kept next to this PDF, so it also appears in cloud-synced folders (OneDrive, Dropbox, etc.); switching it off removes that file.
uitleg.fr: Mémorise la page, la position de défilement et le zoom de ce PDF entre deux ouvertures. Tant que l'option est activée, un petit fichier est conservé à côté de ce PDF ; il apparaît donc aussi dans les dossiers synchronisés avec le cloud (OneDrive, Dropbox, etc.). La désactiver supprime ce fichier.
uitleg.tr: Bu PDF'nin sayfasını, kaydırma konumunu ve yakınlaştırmasını kapatıp yeniden açtığınızda hatırlar. Açık olduğu sürece bu PDF'nin yanında küçük bir dosya tutulur; bu nedenle bulutla eşitlenen klasörlerde de (OneDrive, Dropbox vb.) görünür. Kapatıldığında bu dosya silinir.

mcp.beschrijving: Import a DWG or DXF drawing as a vector PDF page, without opening the import dialog.
Export pages of the current document to DXF or DWG, without opening the export dialog.
Print the current document to a PDF file, without opening the print dialog.
Print the current document to a printer, without opening the print dialog.
Draw a building floor plan with the parts related to each other, instead of loose shapes stacked on top of one another.
Read the LIVE app's interface as a compact accessibility-style tree, to check what a click did without a screenshot.
List the reusable system types (suspended ceilings, floor slabs, panel systems) of the app library, or one type by id.
Register a system type owned by MCP under the id mcp:<key>.
Update a system type owned by MCP (id mcp:<key>).
Open the app's system type editor with the given type selected, or select it in the editor that is already open without discarding unapplied edits.

Get the geometry of one system (suspended ceiling, floor slab, panel field) in the active document, computed by the app's own geometry engine: panels with clipped outlines, grid lines, openings, trimmers, edge segments and component positions, in millimetres in the system's own frame (independent of zoom and view rotation; placement maps it onto the page).
Run a structured command of a loaded extension.
Draw and edit a facade element in a floor plan: a curtain wall or a window frame, as ONE object along a line with an outer frame, mullions on the field boundaries and a panel in every field.

List the app's extensions: every installed and every loaded extension with its id, name, version, installed version, whether it is loaded and activated, its status (active, failed, notLoaded, busy), the code and message of the last failure, who made the last change (ui, mcp or startup) and whether it uses an old-style id.
Install or update an extension from a local .oppx package, without a file dialog and without restarting the app: the package is checked and unpacked by the app, then the new version is activated.
Reload an installed extension from disk: deactivate it, remove everything it registered (ribbon tabs, commands, annotation types, palettes, panels) and activate it again, without restarting the app.
Take the oldest structured agent task that an extension submitted, without the assistant window: the task moves from pending to running and no other client gets it.

Answer a running agent task by its id (from app_agent_task_pending) with either result, an object that must match the task's resultSchema (unknown fields are refused), or error { message, code } when the task cannot be done.
Open a PDF file in a new tab of the running app.
Set the page-view zoom in the LIVE app.
Trigger one zoom-in step in the LIVE app (same as the toolbar +).
Trigger one zoom-out step in the LIVE app (same as the toolbar -).
Capture the LIVE app as a base64 PNG.

Render an area of a page (or the whole page) of the active document as an image at a chosen resolution, the way Home > Screenshot does: the page is rendered again at `dpi` (not the screen pixels enlarged), with the annotations as printed (no selection frames), in the view rotation the user sees.
Dispatch a synthetic mousemove at viewport CSS coordinates (x, y) inside the LIVE WebView.
Dispatch a synthetic mouse click at (x, y).
Dispatch a synthetic drag from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) using `steps` interpolated mousemove events.
Dispatch a synthetic wheel event at (x, y) with delta (dx, dy) in CSS pixels.
Press a single key (with optional modifiers) on the focused element.
Type a string into the focused element.

Probe the LIVE viewport state: render engine + timing chip, active document scale/page/viewMode, pdf-viewport singleton transform, pdf-canvas backing-store + CSS rect, high-zoom tile-overlay state (visible/hidden + position+size), pdf-container CSS rect + scroll offsets, and devicePixelRatio.
Return the most recent matching console messages captured by the in-app observability buffer (mcp-bridge.js).
Dispatch a synthetic ctrl+WheelEvent at (x, y) in the LIVE WebView — exercises the exact same wheel listener the OS hits, so this is a faithful proxy for a user spinning the wheel.

Full cursor-anchor accuracy probe: snapshot pre-zoom canvas+container+tile state at (x, y), dispatch a synthetic ctrl+wheel event, WAIT for renderPage to fully settle (window.__pdfRenderInFlight === 0 + 2 RAFs + 1 setTimeout to drain post-paint tile overlay), then snapshot post-zoom state and compute `anchorErrorPx` — the displacement (in CSS pixels) between where the cursor's world-point WAS before the zoom and where it ENDED UP after.
Force-clear all PDF-related caches: Rust pdfium doc cache, Rust pixmap cache, JS-side ImageBitmap cache.
Navigate the active document to a 1-based page number, exactly as if the user picked the page in the page box or clicked its thumbnail.
Switch the LIVE app's active tool, exactly like clicking the ribbon button.
Click an arbitrary DOM element in the LIVE app by CSS selector (usually '#button-id').
Probe the UI state of a DOM element by CSS selector: { found, visible, disabled, active ('active' class or aria-pressed), text, tag, activatedTab }.
Resize the LIVE app window to a logical width x height.
Return the LIVE app's currently active tool name (state.currentTool).
Merge one or more PDF files into the active document at the given position.
Ask the LIVE app's OpenAEC AI assistant a question (POST /me/ai/complete via the signed-in OpenAEC account).
Report the LIVE app's OpenAEC sign-in state: { ok, signedIn, user:{sub,name,email}|null, brand|null }.
Make an authenticated OpenAEC Accounts API call from the LIVE signed-in app (GET/POST/DELETE to /me/* paths, e.g.
Submit a message into the app's assistant window as if the user typed it (opens the panel).
Take the oldest assistant question waiting for an MCP client to answer (the relay provider).
Answer a pending assistant question (id from app_assistant_pending).
Return the LIVE assistant conversation: { ok, messages:[{ role, content }] }.
Create an annotation on the LIVE app's active document WITHOUT synthetic mouse input.
List the active document's annotations as compact JSON (id, type, page, core geometry, colors, text/measureText, and the markup layer when it is not the default layer).
Return the full JSON-safe property set of one annotation by id (functions/DOM refs stripped).
Merge `props` onto an existing annotation (geometry, color, lineWidth, text, ...).
Delete an annotation by id (records a delete-undo step and redraws).
Select one annotation by id so the properties panel and selection handles show it, exactly like clicking it with the select tool.
Clear the annotation selection and hide the properties panel.
Undo the last annotation/page edit on the active document (same as Ctrl+Z).
Redo the last undone edit on the active document (same as Ctrl+Y).
List all open document tabs: index, fileName, filePath, modified flag, active flag, pageCount, isUntitled, currentPage, annotationCount.
Activate the document tab at `index` (0-based, see app_list_tabs).
Close the document tab at `index` (0-based).
Create a new blank PDF document in a new tab (page size in PDF points; A4 portrait = 595 x 842).
Save the active document with all annotations baked in.
Switch the active document view: 'single' page, 'continuous' vertical scroll, or 'book' (two-page spread, page 1 on the right).
Zoom the active document so the whole page fits the viewport (same as the Fit Page button).
Zoom the active document so the page width fills the viewport (same as the Fit Width button).
Return the active document's page count and current page.
Inspect or save a PDF Collection copy, preserving component bytes, folders, schema, sort and metadata.
Detect heuristic form-field candidates on selected saved PDF pages, excluding existing fields.
Search page artwork for a selected symbol rectangle in current page-view coordinates at scale 1.
Persist mappings from a named schedule on a source PDF to numeric XLSX cells.
Save/export (list) named version-1 document workflows, remove by name, run selected PDF paths into a separate output folder, start explicit watched input/output folders, or stop/cancel.
Manage a portable version-1 multi-file drawing set.
Build reviewed relative PDF links across a package.
Local-file-v1 electronic approval routing, no network sending or certificate signing.
Search text and optional comments in the active PDF, all open PDFs, or PDF files directly in a desktop folder.
List computed markup locations or edit named spatial zones and explicit location overrides.
Inspect structural metadata, comments, embedded files, actions and optional-content indicators in the saved active PDF.
Inspect the saved active PDF against a reusable print profile.
List low/unknown-confidence OCR words with page coordinates and review state, or accept/correct one word.
Read existing PDF page text without mouse automation.
Replace one existing PDF text span returned by app_get_page_text.
Replace many text spans of one page in a single call, for example to translate the page.
Set the active document's measurement scale calibration (pixels per unit + unit, e.g.
Return take-off totals for the user's named schedules (Staten): per schedule the element count, the numeric column grand totals (e.g.
Build a quantities schedule (Staat) from the annotations in the open document and place it on the page as a table annotation.

Set out a structural floor plan in one undoable step: the grid (lettered and numbered grid lines with bubbles), columns on the grid intersections, beams along the grid lines, a span-direction arrow per floor bay carrying the real span, spot elevations, position tags (position number / section / level) and - unless switched off - a quantity schedule grouped by IFC category.
List EVERY function the app exposes: each ribbon tab, each ribbon button on every tab (label, tab, disabled/active state) plus every drawing tool.

Run any command returned by app_list_commands: activates a ribbon tab ('ribbon-tab:<tab>'), clicks the ribbon button (switching to its tab first), runs an extension action ('ext:...') or activates the tool.
Cut a rectangular area from a page of the active document as a VECTOR snippet (not a raster screenshot) and put it on the app's snippet clipboard.
Paste the vector snippet from the snippet clipboard into the active document at real size, as a movable annotation.
List the printers the app knows, with the system default printer and, per printer, the driver, the port and whether it writes to a file instead of to paper.

List the markup layers of the active document in panel order: id, name, colour, visible, printable, locked, the number of markups on it, whether it is the current layer (where new markups land) and whether it is the default layer.
Create a markup layer in the active document, at the end of the layer list.
Change a markup layer of the active document: switch it on or off, make it printable or not, lock or unlock it, rename it, set its colour, or make it the current layer.
Mark a pasted vector snippet as flattened: it stays visible but is no longer selectable, and on the next save it is drawn into the page content instead of being stored as an annotation.
Get or set the placement scale for symbols from the symbol palette (1 = real size, 2 = twice as large).

Read or fill the title block fields by NAME (projectnaam, adres, opdrachtgever, status, projectnr, fase, auteur, schaal, datum_eerste, wijziging, documenttype, kenmerk — whatever the title block defines).
List all PDFs in the test corpus directory.
Render a single PDF page to PNG (returned as base64).
Read PDF version, producer, and per-page metadata.
Render all pages of a PDF as base64 PNGs.
